ms.promise:
Develop the initial AI/ML model, based on research findings
Iterative testing and refining of the model
Define APIs necessary for integration with Cardano wallets
ms.criteria: Outcomes: A functional AI/ML model capable of identifying and flagging potential threats, contributing to enhanced wallet security.
ms.report:
The ML model and classifier can be found here:
https://github.com/adabox-aio/cardano-shield/tree/main/ml

This is the code for training the model with new datasets:
https://github.com/adabox-aio/cardano-shield/blob/main/train.py

The Risk assessment (which will also be used to train an ML model) can be found here:
http://api.cardanoshield.com:8081/swagger-ui/index.html#/cardano-shield-controller/txScan

Blacklists & Whitelists where users can report and update via github
https://github.com/adabox-aio/cardano-shield/tree/main/blacklists
https://github.com/adabox-aio/cardano-shield/tree/main/whitelists

Cardano Shield is using the Random Forest ML model to test URLs if they are considered phishing or safe to browse, the dataset was tweaked to and takes the Cardano Ecosystem context into consideration when running these checks. In addition, Cardano Shield has implemented several tests against any transaction Id that goes through our API’s to classify the risk level of those transactions.
Cardano Shield also updated the community with its progress via twitter and its website
January Update: https://twitter.com/CardanoShield/status/1742220419870990718
Blog: https://www.cardanoshield.com/updates/cardano-shield-january-update

ms.promise:
Design and develop a feedback system to gather data from users
Integrate the feedback system with the threat detection model, allowing it to learn and improve over time
Test the feedback system to ensure it operates as expected
ms.criteria:
A system capable of learning from user-provided data, contributing to the continuous improvement of the AI/ML model.
The expected product is a web browser extension that monitors what sites a user is navigating to. The product will inform the user of malicious sites via an interactive UI. Within the UI it will inform the user where they are navigating to, if they have been there before or not, how risky it is perceived to continue interacting with the URL. This report summarizes the development and deployment of Cardano Shield over the past 12 months. During this period, valuable feedback and requirements have been gathered from our wallet partners and users, contributing to its refinement.
Cardano Shield offers flexible integration options for any Cardano wallet. It can be implemented either through a maintained API endpoint, requiring only minor front-end adjustments for data display, or by forking the open-source project for self-hosting.
As an open-source initiative, Cardano Shield incurs no cost, even when utilizing our API endpoints.
